chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The Fitrah (alms of breaking the fast) is considered Fitrah if you give it before you go out to the Eid prayer; and if it is given after you go out to the Eid prayer, it is considered Sadaqah (general charity).'

key_terms.الْعِيدِ: The Eid prayer, the communal prayer performed on Eid al-Fitr
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةُ: Zakat al-Fitr, the obligatory alms given at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between giving Zakat al-Fitr before and after the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delineates the legal status of the payment based on its timing relative to the Eid prayer: paid before exiting for the prayer, it is the obligatory Zakat al-Fitr, whereas payment after the prayer is considered general Sadaqah. This distinction underscores the specific ritual timing (waqt) required for the purification of the fasting person, a key principle in Shia fiqh regarding the validity of this specific charity.
